title: Warehouse / Station Addresses
description: Maintain your region's main warehouse address and each station's (sub-warehouse) address and coordinates — the Vendor Region Map's "Route Difficulty" prefers a route's own station coordinates for distance, falling back to the region's main warehouse when a station isn't configured.
coordsRequired: Locate the address or drag the pin on the map first
confirmRemoveContent: Routes using this station will fall back to the region's main warehouse for distance.
warehouseNotConfigured: This region has no main warehouse configured yet — routes with an unconfigured station can't fall back to a distance, and will show "insufficient data" in Route Difficulty.
stationsDescription: Pick a station from the dropdown below (same list as the top station selector), then enter its address, locate it, and drag the map pin if needed.
addressPlaceholder: Enter the full address, e.g. 4 Portsmouth Ct, Gillman SA 5013
locateHint: Locating gives an approximate position — if it's off, drag the pin on the map below to fix it.
coordsUnresolved: No coordinates yet — enter an address and click Locate, or click directly on the map.
geocodeNoResult: No results for that address — try a more specific one, or click directly on the map
